items.t: DraftKings (DKNG) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Q3 Miss And Guidance Reset
items.sum: The analyst fair value estimate for DraftKings has shifted from US$33.23 to US$26.40, which marks a clear reset in the stock’s valuation anchor. This change comes as Street research turns more cautious following the Q3 2026 miss, the guidance reset, and the debate over how the heavier Predictions investment should factor into long term expectations. items.t: DraftKings Falls 5% as Zacks Names It Bear of the Day, Sees “A Clear Road Lower”
items.sum: Key TakeawaysDraftKings fell 5% today after Zacks named it its Bear of the Day, and Flutter Entertainment fell too. Analysts still expect DraftKings’ earnings per share to nearly triple in 2027.
